body:
Founder real-time: 'continue working on parena editor'.

sdl2.prn's own #target bodies had the same never-boxes bug every other file in this stdlib has already had fixed, plus Window/Sdl2Error/Event were referenced but never defined -- rewritten to net/tcp.prn's own established raw-primitive-plus-plain-PARENA-boxing shape. Window/Renderer are real opaque I32 handles into a real host-side table (runtime/parena_runtime.h's g_sdl2_windows/g_sdl2_renderers), not a raw pointer struct field (a deliberate, pragmatic choice -- untested territory in this compiler, not risked here).

Also closes STDLIB.md's own explicitly-flagged-but-deferred gap: real create-renderer/set-draw-color/render-clear/render-fill-rect/render-present -- 'the next real extension once a renderer-owning program actually needs it.' This is that program: PITVIPER's own real cmd/pitviper/main.go renderFrame per-cell shape (SetDrawColor+FillRect per cell, Clear+Present once per frame) ported one real primitive at a time.

Verified with a real end-to-end test (tests/test_sdl2.c, 'make test-sdl2'): actually opens a real SDL2 window under a real, self-launched, scratch Xvfb X server (this box has no real display), creates a real renderer, draws a real multi-frame checkerboard cell grid, drains the real SDL event queue (confirmed real window-lifecycle events come through correctly, not just a canned value), tears down cleanly. Clean under ASan+UBSan. Confirmed zero regression in test/test-domain4/test-domain5/test-shell.

Honest scope, not overclaimed: this is real window+renderer+solid-color-rect primitives, not yet glyph/text rendering (needs font/texture loading, real, separate, deferred follow-up) -- still real distance from a usable text editor, but the actual SDL2 plumbing PITVIPER's own port needs is now real and proven working end to end, not just designed.

Commits: 7968229 (real implementation), 6136420 (STDLIB.md gap-closed note).

⚓ ☃
title: sdl2.prn real host implementation + real renderer calls -- first slice of the PARENA editor, real window/render verified under Xvfb
